title: I honestly can’t believe I’m writing this, but StoneEra just reached 1,017 wishlists on Steam! 🎉
author: Arrock12
selftext:
When I first started working on this game as a solo developer, I had no idea whether anyone would actually be interested in playing it.  
Before Steam Next Fest, I had around 335 wishlists. By the end of the festival, that number had grown to around 650. I thought things would slow down significantly afterward, but somehow the wishlists just kept coming.  
And now we’ve officially crossed **1,000!**  
I know 1,000 might not sound like a huge number compared to bigger indie games, but for someone building a game alone, it genuinely means a lot.  
Every wishlist reminds me that there’s someone out there who wants to see this little voxel world come to life.  
Thank you to everyone who tried the demo, shared feedback, or simply added the game to their wishlist. ❤️  
Still a long road ahead, but this milestone feels special.  
**Steam:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/)
